verdict.rationale: Pulumi lets users keep state in a DIY backend, an object store they manage themselves (S3, Azure Blob, GCS), and offers self-hosting. That indirectly gives users control over where their data lives and how long it is kept, and a community user confirms the self-managed state option. There is no first-party documentation of retention settings, deletion controls, or data-purge policies for Pulumi Cloud, so this support is implied rather than explicit. Missing for 10: documented retention policies, explicit data/state deletion controls for Pulumi Cloud, account/data purge procedures, independent corroboration.
